## Context / immutable audit base
At d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1, these four reducer files contain 42 confirmed bloated prose blocks. The former older-SHA ranges mixed code with prose and missed long cache, managed-reference, workflow, and migration explanations. Lines are immutable-base citations only.

## Exact prose allowlist

## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve append-only retired-event handling, cache-version bump semantics, attestation validity-on-read, immutable snapshot stores, dir-hash inputs, and rebuild/cache separation. Preserve monotonic managed_refs, provider-neutral keying, tolerant parsing, migration seeding, and delete-versus-adopt behavior. Preserve winner-only claim/close metadata, session clearing, lexical UUID fork convergence, derived conflict evidence, reopen invalidation, legacy creation-channel inference, unresolved-blocker tombstone behavior, workflow/step LWW keys, commit union, tag add-wins, and all snapshot migrations. These reducers feed every show/list/search, compaction, gate, and reconciler read; no allowlisted docstring has a programmatic __doc__ consumer.

All non-allowlisted prose and all runtime strings, assertions, fixtures, decorators, config values/keys, directives, and shebangs stay byte-identical. Preserve _processors.py F401 directives at 21/23/24/27/28/29/30 and BLE001 at 259. The other three files have no audited directive/shebang lines.

## Verification and independent review
Parse base/final with type_comments=True; strip only allowlisted owner docstrings, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require remaining AST/runtime equality plus directive/shebang physical-line equality. Require exact HEAD^..HEAD paths. Run focused reducer/cache/compaction contracts, path diff-check, hygiene, and untimed worktree-venv make verify.

A non-author reviewer records a leaf-linked TSV with exactly 42 PASS rows: stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_pass, bloat_pass. Each block must shrink.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly the 42 allowlisted blocks are shortened; all other prose/directives are unchanged.
- [ ] The immutable AST/runtime and directive oracle passes for all four files.
- [ ] Every cache, reference, convergence, workflow, and migration contract has an independent-review PASS citation.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the four paths; focused checks, diff-check, hygiene, and make verify exit 0.
- [ ] The independent TSV has exactly 42 complete PASS rows with lower final word counts.
